expected.title: Plugins for GitHub Copilot
expected.intro: Plugins package related customizations so you can install them together across supported Copilot surfaces.
expected.product:
GitHub Copilot CLI is available with all Copilot plans. If you receive Copilot from an organization, the Copilot CLI policy must be enabled in the organization's settings.

Copilot cloud agent is available for all paid Copilot plans. The agent is available in all repositories stored on GitHub, except repositories owned by managed user accounts and where it has been explicitly disabled.

The GitHub Copilot app is available for all Copilot plans.
Sign up for Copilot (icon: link-external)
